item.title: Jeffries faces impeachment dilemma if Democrats win House
item.description: With 10 weeks until midterms, House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries hinted to CNN's Wolf Blitzer about potential impeachment actions if Democrats regain control.

item.title: Trump's threat to cut police funding over election integrity
item.description: States and cities are resisting the White House's plan to withhold millions in police and anti-terrorism funds unless they comply with election demands.

item.title: Court ruling may weaken Republicans' midterm ad advantage
item.description: A federal appeals court's 2-1 ruling could block Republicans from using certain campaign funds for TV ads, potentially affecting their midterm strategy.

item.title: Backlash grows over Jeffries-Kushner meeting
item.description: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries faces renewed criticism from progressives after his meeting with Jared Kushner became public.
